\section[(dialogue)]{The body and people at work — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R137-first-pass-the-body-and-people-at-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for tired and healthy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a wallet, a coin, an envelope, a stamp, a doll
  \item a ball, a flute, a tabla, a guitar, a camera
  \item a phone, a radio, light, a bed, a mattress
  \item a mosquito net, a blanket, a curtain, a vase, a cup
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A wallet? (\textbf{\bn{মানিব্যাগ}}, \emph{mānibyāg}.) A coin? (\textbf{\bn{পয়সা}}, \emph{pôysā}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\bn{খাম}}, \emph{khām}.) A stamp? (\textbf{\bn{ডাকটিকিট}}, \emph{ḍākṭikiṭ}.) A doll? (\textbf{\bn{পুতুল}}, \emph{putul}.) A ball? (\textbf{\bn{বল}}, \emph{bôl}.) A flute? (\textbf{\bn{বাঁশি}}, \emph{bā̃shi}.) A tabla? (\textbf{\bn{তবলা}}, \emph{tôblā}.) A guitar? (\textbf{\bn{গিটার}}, \emph{giṭār}.) A camera? (\textbf{\bn{ক্যামেরা}}, \emph{kyāmerā}.) A phone? (\textbf{\bn{ফোন}}, \emph{phon}.) A radio? (\textbf{\bn{রেডিও}}, \emph{rediyo}.) Light? (\textbf{\bn{আলো}}, \emph{ālo}.) A bed? (\textbf{\bn{খাট}}, \emph{khāṭ}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\bn{তোশক}}, \emph{toshôk}.) A mosquito net? (\textbf{\bn{মশারি}}, \emph{môshāri}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\bn{কম্বল}}, \emph{kômbôl}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\bn{পর্দা}}, \emph{pôrdā}.) A vase? (\textbf{\bn{ফুলদানি}}, \emph{phuldāni}.) A cup? (\textbf{\bn{কাপ}}, \emph{kāp}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The town and describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R137-second-pass-the-town-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for short and spicy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item short, spicy, salty, hard, soft
  \item wet, dry, full, fast, slow
  \item deep, wide, narrow, round, purple
  \item pink, sad, angry, tired, healthy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Short? (\textbf{\bn{বেঁটে}}, \emph{beṭe}.) Spicy? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাল}}, \emph{jhāl}.) Salty? (\textbf{\bn{নোনতা}}, \emph{nontā}.) Hard? (\textbf{\bn{শক্ত}}, \emph{shôktô}.) Soft? (\textbf{\bn{নরম}}, \emph{nôrôm}.) Wet? (\textbf{\bn{ভিজে}}, \emph{bhije}.) Dry? (\textbf{\bn{শুকনো}}, \emph{shukno}.) Full? (\textbf{\bn{ভরা}}, \emph{bhôrā}.) Fast? (\textbf{\bn{দ্রুত}}, \emph{drutô}.) Slow? (\textbf{\bn{ধীর}}, \emph{dhīr}.) Deep? (\textbf{\bn{গভীর}}, \emph{gôbhīr}.) Wide? (\textbf{\bn{চওড়া}}, \emph{chôoṛā}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\bn{সরু}}, \emph{sôru}.) Round? (\textbf{\bn{গোল}}, \emph{gol}.) Purple? (\textbf{\bn{বেগুনি}}, \emph{beguni}.) Pink? (\textbf{\bn{গোলাপি}}, \emph{golāpi}.) Sad? (\textbf{\bn{দুঃখী}}, \emph{dukhi}.) Angry? (\textbf{\bn{রাগী}}, \emph{rāgi}.) Tired? (\textbf{\bn{ক্লান্ত}}, \emph{klāntô}.) Healthy? (\textbf{\bn{সুস্থ}}, \emph{susthô}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
